prompt: ISO 26262: what are the technical requirements for the functional requirement "HMI shall be able to detect errors or unplausible data in the data stream and diplay a warning on driver display"?
response: ISO 26262 does not provide specific technical requirements for detecting errors or unplausible data in the data stream. It is recommended to follow general software development practices for error handling. The warning display can be a simple alert without additional safety implications.
